items.rationale: New Meta ad-platform release: Meta is testing AI campaign-import and creative-insight features plus better conversational guidance in its AI tools - directly changes how advertisers build and iterate creative on Meta.
items.excerpt: The company is testing importing and creative insight features, as well as improved conversational guidance for its artificial intelligence elements.

items.rationale: First disclosed brand performance number for ChatGPT ads: DoubleVerify says Weight Watchers' CPA ran 15.3% below benchmark, and Rockerbox now treats ChatGPT as an attribution touchpoint.
items.excerpt: Rockerbox users can now treat ChatGPT as a touchpoint, and a suitability pilot with OpenAI is in development. Will early results arrive with disclosed methods?

items.rationale: Actionable tomorrow: Google Ads adds AI Max reporting columns (brand inclusions, locations of interest, commission, optimized targeting), giving buyers visibility into what the AI expansion is doing.
items.excerpt: Google Ads is adding new AI Max related columns to the Google Ads reporting console.  The columns include brand inclusions, locations of interest, commission and optimized targeting.

items.rationale: A concrete AI ad-creative case study: OK Future compressed Goodwipes' AI campaign work from weeks to days, showing both the cost upside and the human toll of high-speed AI production.
items.excerpt: OK Future squeezed Goodwipes' AI project from weeks into days, proving the financial upside and psychological toll of high-speed AI workflows.

items.rationale: Retail-side AI shift: Walmart U.S. CEO David Guggina says AI, led by the Sparky shopping agent, is cutting costs that Walmart reinvests in customer experience - a signal of where retail-media and shopper-marketing attention is moving.
items.excerpt: Advancements in AI are helping Walmart save money, which it is, in turn, reinvesting in customer experience improvements, according to U.S. CEO David Guggina.
